sloka: ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवेयं सत्येनाहं ब्रवीमि ते ।रावणेनोपरुद्धां मां निकृत्या पापकर्मणा ।। ५.३८.६८।।।।
transliteration: ūrdhvaṁ māsānna jīveyaṁ satyenāhaṁ bravīmi te ।rāvaṇenoparuddhāṁ māṁ nikṛtyā pāpakarmaṇā ।। 5.38.68।।।।

translations.english: "O heroic Rama just as Kausik was rescued from the underworld it behoves you to deliver me from imprisonment of wicked Ravana".
